explanations.finding_reason: Isolation Forest: more unusual than 99.8% of 4477 real training minutes from this sensor (outlier score -0.0755); requests_per_minute 51.0, http_4xx_ratio 0.902, unique_clients 1, failed_auth 0
explanations.summary: The model flagged this minute from the secrepo.com web server: it is more unusual than 99.8% of the 4,477 normal minutes it learned from. Main reason: Requests per minute was 51, higher than 99.1% of normal minutes. Also contributing: Share of requests that failed (HTTP 4xx).

features.label: Requests per minute
features.sentence: Requests per minute was 51, higher than the usual 1 (higher than 99% of normal minutes). This made the minute look more unusual and accounts for 52% of the decision.

features.sentence: Share of requests that failed (HTTP 4xx) was 90%, higher than the usual 0% (higher than 99% of normal minutes). This made the minute look more unusual and accounts for 46% of the decision.

method: Model: scikit-learn Isolation Forest (200 trees, 2% expected outliers), trained only on the earliest 70% of this sensor's real one-minute history (SecRepo) and never on the minutes it is tested on.
Explanation: SHAP TreeExplainer computes each feature's exact contribution to this minute's isolation path length, compared with an average training minute. Negative = pushed towards 'unusual'.
Percentiles compare each value with the same feature in the training minutes.
limitations: An outlier is unusual for this sensor, not proof of an attack; SW-ML-001 findings are low severity, low confidence.
SHAP explains the model's decision, not the attacker's intent. Features interact: a value can matter only in combination with another.
The baseline is the sensor's own past: if the past contained attacks, the model treats them as normal.
